chunks: The fortunate one is he who learns a lesson from others.

key_terms.اَلسَّعِيدُ: the fortunate one; the truly successful person
key_terms.بِغَيْرِهِ: through others; by observing the condition or experience of others

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about learning lessons from others?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that true fortune lies in taking admonition from what happens to other people, without needing to fall into the same errors oneself. It highlights moral awareness, reflection, and the wisdom of learning through observation.
